scope: 10 finite public-input GameSession runs. No browser, GPU, performance, human-fun or retention claim.

policy.stationary: Saved only1 action, modal and growth bytes unchanged.
policy.active: Same old growth/modal bytes; prioritize visible standoff identity, navigate to 450, sidestep frozen thin rays, Q toward selected target whenever ready; tool1 only, no dash/2/3/E.
policy.stationaryTargetedQ: Original stationary nearest-target/fire/movement/choice code. Only while a living standoff exists and scanReady<=elapsed, add scan=true and aim at it for that frame; otherwise restore original aim. Movement always zero; no Q without standoff.
policy.mutationScope: Only original public start/step/discardDraft/chooseCombatUpgrade/resume. No state/HP/position/clock/target/equipment injection.
policy.assertionPolicy: No forced victory, damage, cell hit or failure; all deaths, stalls, timeouts and measurement errors retained without retries.
